SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Special Branch.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY 4543/18）
No. D
Date May 28, 1932

Subject (in full) Illegal Functioning of Public Safety Bureau Agents.

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao Liang.

I had an interview with Dr. Hung, Chief of 2nd
Department of the Public Safety Bureau, at 3 p.m. May 26 and
brought to his notice the irregular action of the two agents
in making an arrest in the Settlement with cooperation of
the S.M.P. pointing out that their irregularities may lead
to serious consequences. Dr. Hung agreed to warn Mr.
Liu Hwa accordingly.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：签名字迹）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别股。
报告

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别股登记处 4543/18）
D 号
日期 1932年5月28日

事由（全称） 公安局探员非法行事。

由 谭绍良 督察长 制作并呈送。

我于5月26日下午3时会见了公安局第二处处长洪博士，向他指出了两名探员在工部局警务处配合下于租界内实施逮捕的不当行为，并指出其违规行为可能导致严重后果。洪博士同意据此警告刘华先生。

谭绍良
督察长。

特别股主管警官。

（批：签名字迹）

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

Arrest of Suspected Communist on 20.5.34.

Sir,

At 7.30 p.m. May 20, 1934 C.P.C. 3188 brought to this station three male Chinese, names and particulars as follows:

(1) Han Lou Hou (韓魯候), an agent of the Special Branch of the Bureau of Public Safety.

(2) Tsung Ta Ming (陳子明), an agent of the Special Branch of the Bureau of Public Safety.

(3) Tsung Hai Dzang (陳海章), aged □, native of Chekiang, M/Unemployed, residing at Lane 35, House No. 1 Tientungan Road, Chapei.

C.P.C. 3188 stated that he had found the above three mentioned individuals fighting on Avenue Haig near Yu Yuen Road, and that the B.P.S. agents had accused the other of being a communist and that he had exploded a firecracker on the ground, the remains of which the C.P.C. could not find.

All were questioned by D.S. Mitto and D.L. Eh Juu Hsu of the Special Branch and D.S.I. Wu Chen Ho, C.P.C. 3188 and the interpreters.

(1) 韩鲁候 (Han Lou Hou)，公安局特别股探员。

been received to the effect that a communistic
demonstration would be held at the "asket" air on the
evening of May 20, 1934 and that a cracker would be
fired as a signal to commence the same. This notice
had instructed the following five agents, etc. to pro-
ceed to the vicinity of the "asket" air in order to
keep observation in regard to any possible radical
happenings:

(1) Inspector Van Yoeng ( 范 瑢 )
(2) Han Lou Hea ( 韓 魯 候 )
(3) Tsang Ta Ming ( 陳 子 明 )
(4) Kao Jang Ming ( 高 強 民 )
(5) Kyung Iang ( 金 陵 )

Shortly after 7 p.m. the P.S.B. agents alleged
that they saw Tsung Hai Dzung ( 陳 漢 章 ) and several
other persons loitering about the roadways and kept
them under observation until 7.25 p.m. when he was
seen to take a cracker from his pocket and throw it to
the ground where it exploded. They thereupon
arrested him.

The accused when questioned denied having thrown
a cracker and stated that he had come to Shanghai in
order to seek employment, which statement was proved
by various letters he produced. He also stated
that he is in no way connected with any political party

收到通知称，1934年5月20日晚将在“asket”空地举行共产党示威活动，并将燃放爆竹作为开始信号。该通知指示以下五名探员等前往“asket”空地附近，以便观察任何可能的激进事件：

(1) 范瑢 督察 (Inspector Van Yoeng)
(2) 韩鲁候 (Han Lou Hea)
(3) 陈子明 (Tsang Ta Ming)
(4) 高强民 (Kao Jang Ming)
(5) 金陵 (Kyung Iang)

晚上7点后不久，公安局探员声称看见陈汉章 (Tsung Hai Dzung) 及其他几人在道路上徘徊，并对他们进行监视，直到晚上7时25分，看见他从口袋中取出一只爆竹扔在地上，爆竹随即爆炸。他们随即将其逮捕。

被告在接受讯问时否认投掷爆竹，并称他来上海是为了求职，他出示的多封信件证明了这一说法。他还声明他与任何政党均无任何关联

Shanghai, 20/5/34.
Anhwei.
P.I. Suh Pao Hwa.
B'ell Stn.
20/5/34.
-do-

I am an investigating officer of the Shanghai Bureau of
Public Safety and at about 6pm. on 20/5/34 I went to the Special
Branch of the S.M.P. and saw a circular notification issued by
Mr. Liu Hwa, officer i/c Special Branch was posted in our office
to the effect that a communistic demonstration would take place
in the vicinity of the National Goods Bazaar on B'ell between
6-30pm. and 7-0pm. on 20/5/34, and instructing all officers
concerned, and not otherwise engaged, to proceed to the place
mentioned and make investigations.

Accompanied by Inspector Van Yoong and three other agents
I went by 'bus to the vicinity of the National Goods Bazaar
at the former site of St. George's and arrived there at about
6-30pm. On arrival, we scattered outside and inside the bazaar
to await developments. At about 7-0pm. I saw a male Chinese
acting very suspiciously outside the Bazaar and whispering to
another person. He then entered the bazaar and was followed by
some ten other persons of the working or student class. He then
took a cracker from his pocket and threw it to the ground. This
act was witnessed by one of the agents named Tsang Ts
Ming, and I caught hold of him. Some other people attempted to
rescue him but were pushed back. I was then attempting to take
him to B'ell Station when C.P.C. 5138 came up, and I told him
about the affair. The C.P.C. then picked up the remainder of
the cracker, but failed to produce same when he came to this
station with us.

上海，1934年5月20日。
安徽。
P.I. Suh Pao Hwa。
静安寺巡捕房。
1934年5月20日。
同上

我是上海公安局的调查员，1934年5月20日下午6点左右，我前往工部局警务处特别股，看到一份由特别股主管刘华先生发布的通告张贴在我们办公室内，内容称1934年5月20日下午6时30分至7时之间，将在静安寺国货商场附近举行共产党示威活动，并指示所有有关且无其他任务的警官前往上述地点进行调查。

在范瑢督察和其他三名探员的陪同下，我乘公共汽车前往原圣乔治球场旧址附近的国货商场，并于下午6时30分左右到达。抵达后，我们在商场内外分散开来等待事态发展。下午7点左右，我看见一名中国男子在商场外行为非常可疑，并与另一人耳语。随后他进入商场，另有约十名工人或学生阶级的人跟随其后。接着他从口袋里拿出一只爆竹扔在地上。这一举动被一名名为陈子明 (Tsang Ts Ming) 的探员目击，我随即抓住了他。其他人试图营救他，但被推开。当时我正试图将他带往静安寺巡捕房，中国警员 5138 号赶了上来，我便将此事告知了他。该中国警员随后捡起了爆竹残骸，但当他与我们一同来到本署时，却未能出示该残骸。

Tsung Hai Dzang (陳漢章) alias Tsu Lin (徐林)
Chekiang
S. S. Pitts.
Bubbling Well Stn. 20.5.34. C.I.D.

I am married, unemployed at present residing at House
No. 1, Lane 33, Tientungan Road, Chapei. I arrived in
Shanghai three days ago from Ling Hai (臨海), Chekiang, with
the object of proceeding to Nanking to obtain employment.
Arriving in Shanghai I went to House No. 1, Lane No. 33
Tientungan Road where I am still residing. During the three
days that I have been in Shanghai I have visited various
acquaintances with the intention of borrowing money to enable
me to purchase a passage to Nanking. This evening I made
my way to the Basket Fair being curious to see it, and at
about 7.30 p.m. whilst at the Fair near the Bazaar two Chinese
(J.S.B. agents) caught hold of me and accused me of firing
crackers. I definitely did not fire any crackers and I denied
their assertions. I had no idea as to what their object was
in assaulting me. After this incident these two men dragged
me along the roadway towards the police station for about 10
yards. A C.P.C. then appeared and brought the three of us to
Bubbling Well Station.

I am not a member of any political party and am not affiliated in any way to any political organisation.

Signed:- Tsung Hai Dzang.

陈海章 (Tsung Hai Dzang)，别名徐林 (Tsu Lin)
浙江
S. S. Pitts。
静安寺巡捕房 1934年5月20日。刑事侦缉处。

我已婚，目前无业，居住于闸北天通庵路33弄1号。三天前我从浙江临海抵达上海，目的是前往南京求职。抵达上海后，我前往天通庵路33弄1号，至今仍居住于此。在上海的三天里，我拜访了多位熟人，意图借钱以购买前往南京的车票。今晚我出于好奇前往篮街集市（Basket Fair），晚上7时30分左右，当我在集市靠近商场处时，两名中国人（公安局特别股探员）抓住我，指控我燃放爆竹。我绝对没有燃放任何爆竹，并否认了他们的指控。我不知道他们袭击我的目的何在。事发后，这两人拖着我沿马路向警察局方向走了约10码。随后一名中国警员出现，将我们三人带至静安寺巡捕房。

我不是任何政党的成员，与任何政治组织均无任何隶属关系。

签名：- 陈海章。
